title: Site Reliability Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to become a competent SRE from scratch, covering Linux fundamentals to advanced reliability practices. Follow the phases to build skills, create portfolio projects, and prepare for job readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build core system knowledge and basic programming ability.

milestones.title: Linux and Networking Basics
milestones.outcome: You can navigate the Linux command line, manage services, and troubleshoot basic network issues.

tasks.title: Read Linux command line tutorial
tasks.description: Study the introductory sections of the Linux Documentation Project to learn file navigation, permissions, and process management.

tasks.title: Install a virtual Linux VM
tasks.description: Set up a Ubuntu virtual machine using VirtualBox and explore the terminal.

tasks.title: Configure static IP and test ping
tasks.description: Edit network settings to assign a static IP and verify connectivity with ping and traceroute.

tasks.title: Reflect on common networking commands
tasks.description: Write a short note on when to use ifconfig, netstat, and ss.

tasks.title: Join a Linux beginners forum
tasks.description: Create an account on LinuxQuestions.org and introduce yourself to the community.

milestones.title: Introductory Programming
milestones.outcome: You can write simple scripts to automate system tasks.

tasks.title: Complete Python basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the first three sections covering variables, control flow, and functions.

tasks.title: Write a script to monitor disk usage
tasks.description: Create a Python script that logs disk space every minute to a file.

tasks.title: Run the script with cron
tasks.description: Schedule the script using crontab to execute automatically.

tasks.title: Debug a failing script
tasks.description: Introduce a deliberate error, then use traceback to locate and fix it.

tasks.title: Share your script on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a repository, commit the code, and write a README explaining its purpose.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop observability, incident handling, and reliability concepts.

milestones.title: Observability Foundations
milestones.outcome: You can instrument services with metrics, logs, and traces using open‑source tools.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus official docs (Getting Started)
tasks.description: Understand the architecture, data model, and basic configuration.

tasks.title: Install Prometheus on Docker
tasks.description: Run a Prometheus container, add a node exporter, and verify metrics collection.

tasks.title: Create a Grafana dashboard
tasks.description: Connect Grafana to Prometheus and visualize CPU and memory usage.

tasks.title: Log a sample application to Loki
tasks.description: Deploy Loki, configure the app to send logs, and query them in Grafana.

tasks.title: Summarize key observability pillars
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of metrics, logs, and traces and their trade‑offs.

milestones.title: Incident Management & SLOs
milestones.outcome: You can define service level objectives and run a structured incident response.

tasks.title: Read Google SRE book chapter on SLOs (free excerpt)
tasks.description: Identify how to choose error budgets and set targets.

tasks.title: Define an SLO for a demo web service
tasks.description: Choose a latency target, calculate error budget, and document it in a markdown file.

tasks.title: Simulate an outage and run a runbook
tasks.description: Stop the demo service, follow a simple runbook, and restore it while noting steps.

tasks.title: Write a post‑mortem draft
tasks.description: Structure a post‑mortem with timeline, root cause, and remediation actions.

tasks.title: Discuss the post‑mortem with a peer
tasks.description: Share the draft in a community Slack channel and gather feedback.

milestones.title: Distributed Systems Basics
milestones.outcome: You understand key concepts like replication, consensus, and fault tolerance.

tasks.title: Watch MIT 6.824 lecture 1 (free on YouTube)
tasks.description: Get an overview of distributed system challenges and terminology.

tasks.title: Deploy a single‑node Redis cluster
tasks.description: Install Redis, enable persistence, and test basic read/write operations.

tasks.title: Experiment with Redis replication
tasks.description: Add a replica, trigger a failover, and observe data consistency.

tasks.title: Explain CAP theorem in your own words
tasks.description: Write a brief explanation and give a real‑world example.

tasks.title: Join a distributed‑systems meetup group online
tasks.description: Introduce yourself and ask a question about replication strategies.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase SRE capabilities.

milestones.title: Monitoring Stack with Alerts
milestones.outcome: You can deploy a full monitoring solution and configure alerting rules.

tasks.title: Design architecture diagram
tasks.description: Sketch components: Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, exporters.

tasks.title: Deploy stack using Docker Compose
tasks.description: Write a compose file that brings up all services on a single host.

tasks.title: Create alert for high CPU usage
tasks.description: Add a rule in Alertmanager to fire when CPU > 80% for 5 minutes.

tasks.title: Document setup in a README
tasks.description: Explain each component, how to start it, and how alerts are routed.

tasks.title: Publish project on GitHub
tasks.description: Push the repository, enable GitHub Pages for the diagram, and add a demo video link.

milestones.title: Load Test and Capacity Report
milestones.outcome: You can perform load testing, analyze results, and recommend capacity changes.

tasks.title: Read k6 quickstart guide (official docs)
tasks.description: Learn how to write a basic load script and run it locally.

tasks.title: Write a k6 script for a sample API
tasks.description: Simulate 100 concurrent users for 5 minutes and record latency.

tasks.title: Run the script and capture metrics
tasks.description: Execute the load test, export results to CSV, and view graphs in Grafana.

tasks.title: Draft a capacity report
tasks.description: Summarize findings, identify bottlenecks, and suggest scaling options.

tasks.title: Share report with a mentor for feedback
tasks.description: Post the document in a professional forum and request critique.

milestones.title: Simulated Outage Post‑mortem
milestones.outcome: You can produce a professional post‑mortem that demonstrates root‑cause analysis.

tasks.title: Create a scripted outage scenario
tasks.description: Write a bash script that stops a service and logs timestamps.

tasks.title: Execute the scenario and record timeline
tasks.description: Run the script, capture logs, and note detection and recovery times.

tasks.title: Write a detailed post‑mortem
tasks.description: Include timeline, impact, root cause, and remediation plan.

tasks.title: Format post‑mortem using SRE template
tasks.description: Apply the Google SRE post‑mortem template for consistency.

tasks.title: Publish post‑mortem on personal blog
tasks.description: Create a blog post, embed logs, and share the link on LinkedIn.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance expertise, polish the portfolio, and prepare for interviews or client work.

milestones.title: Advanced SLO & Reliability Design
milestones.outcome: You can design multi‑metric SLOs and evaluate reliability trade‑offs.

tasks.title: Read advanced SLO chapter from Google SRE book
tasks.description: Focus on multi‑dimensional error budgets and budgeting across services.

tasks.title: Create composite SLO for two services
tasks.description: Combine latency and error rate metrics into a single error budget.

tasks.title: Simulate budget consumption and alert
tasks.description: Generate synthetic data to trigger the composite SLO breach and observe alerts.

tasks.title: Write a short case study
tasks.description: Explain why the composite SLO improves reliability for the scenario.

tasks.title: Discuss case study with a senior SRE on Reddit
tasks.description: Post the study in r/devops and ask for feedback.

milestones.title: Production‑grade Incident Management
milestones.outcome: You can lead an incident using runbooks, communication channels, and post‑mortem processes.

tasks.title: Study PagerDuty incident workflow (free docs)
tasks.description: Learn how incidents are created, escalated, and resolved.

tasks.title: Create a mock runbook for database outage
tasks.description: Write step‑by‑step actions, communication templates, and rollback plan.

tasks.title: Role‑play an incident with a peer
tasks.description: Simulate detection, escalation, and resolution while timing each step.

tasks.title: Evaluate the runbook effectiveness
tasks.description: Write notes on gaps, missing info, and improvements.

tasks.title: Add the runbook to your portfolio repo
tasks.description: Include it in the GitHub repository with clear documentation.

milestones.title: Interview & Job Readiness
milestones.outcome: You can confidently discuss SRE concepts and showcase your projects in interviews.

tasks.title: Review common SRE interview questions (Glassdoor)
tasks.description: Read and note answers for topics like error budgets, load testing, and alert fatigue.

tasks.title: Prepare an elevator pitch for your portfolio
tasks.description: Craft a 60‑second summary highlighting the monitoring stack, load test, and post‑mortem projects.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 30‑minute technical interview focusing on Linux, networking, and reliability scenarios.

tasks.title: Update résumé with SRE keywords
tasks.description: Add sections for Linux, Observability, Incident Management, and Distributed Systems.

tasks.title: Apply to three entry‑level SRE roles
tasks.description: Submit tailored applications and track responses in a spreadsheet.
